# 662. Cliente bÃ¡sico en Python

El siguiente ejemplo utiliza Ãºnicamente la biblioteca estÃ¡ndar y analiza una respuesta Atom.

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from dataclasses import dataclass


ATOM = "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"
ARXIV = "http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Paper:
    arxiv_id: str
    title: str
    abstract: str
    authors: tuple[str, ...]
    published: str
    updated: str
    primary_category: str | None
    categories: tuple[str, ...]
    doi: str | None


def clean_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    return " ".join((value or "").split())


def search_arxiv(
    query: str,
    *,
    start: int = 0,
    max_results: int = 20,
    timeout: int = 30,
) -> list[Paper]:
    if max_results < 1 or max_results > 100:
        raise ValueError("max_results debe estar entre 1 y 100.")

    params = urllib.parse.urlencode(
        {
            "search_query": query,
            "start": start,
            "max_results": max_results,
            "sortBy": "submittedDate",
            "sortOrder": "descending",
        }
    )
    endpoint = f"https://export.arxiv.org/api/query?{params}"

    request = urllib.request.Request(
        endpoint,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": "investigacion-arxiv/1.0 "
            "(contacto: investigador@example.org)"
        },
    )

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            xml_data = response.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No fue posible consultar arXiv: {exc}") from exc

    root = ET.fromstring(xml_data)
    papers: list[Paper] = []

    for entry in root.findall(f"{{{ATOM}}}entry"):
        entry_id = clean_text(entry.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}id"))
        arxiv_id = entry_id.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]

        authors = tuple(
            clean_text(author.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}name"))
            for author in entry.findall(f"{{{ATOM}}}author")
        )

        categories = tuple(
            node.attrib["term"]
            for node in entry.findall(f"{{{ATOM}}}category")
            if "term" in node.attrib
        )

        primary = entry.find(f"{{{ARXIV}}}primary_category")
        doi = clean_text(entry.findtext(f"{{{ARXIV}}}doi")) or None

        papers.append(
            Paper(
                arxiv_id=arxiv_id,
                title=clean_text(entry.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}title")),
                abstract=clean_text(entry.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}summary")),
                authors=authors,
                published=clean_text(
                    entry.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}published")
                ),
                updated=clean_text(
                    entry.findtext(f"{{{ATOM}}}updated")
                ),
                primary_category=(
                    primary.attrib.get("term") if primary is not None else None
                ),
                categories=categories,
                doi=doi,
            )
        )

    return papers


if __name__ == "__main__":
    results = search_arxiv(
        '(cat:cs.CL OR cat:cs.LG) AND abs:"large language model"',
        max_results=10,
    )

    for paper in results:
        print(paper.arxiv_id, paper.title)

    # Pausa prudente antes de realizar otra solicitud.
    time.sleep(3)
```

El correo de contacto del agente de usuario debe sustituirse por una direcciÃ³n real del proyecto.

# 663. RecolecciÃ³n paginada en Python

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path


def harvest_query(
    query: str,
    output_file: Path,
    *,
    page_size: int = 100,
    max_pages: int = 10,
    delay_seconds: float = 3.0,
) -> None:
    seen: set[str] = set()

    with output_file.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        for page_number in range(max_pages):
            start = page_number * page_size

            papers = search_arxiv(
                query,
                start=start,
                max_results=page_size,
            )

            if not papers:
                break

            new_records = 0
            for paper in papers:
                if paper.arxiv_id in seen:
                    continue

                seen.add(paper.arxiv_id)
                handle.write(
                    json.dumps(
                        asdict(paper),
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    )
                    + "\n"
                )
                new_records += 1

            if new_records == 0:
                break

            time.sleep(delay_seconds)
```

Este ejemplo conserva un registro por lÃ­nea en formato JSON Lines, facilita la reanudaciÃ³n y deduplica por identificador.

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import feedparser
import requests


API_URL = "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ArxivRecord:
    arxiv_id: str
    title: str
    summary: str
    authors: tuple[str, ...]
    published: str
    updated: str
    categories: tuple[str, ...]
    pdf_url: str | None


def normalize_arxiv_id(entry_id: str) -> str:
    """Extrae el identificador y conserva el sufijo de versiÃ³n."""
    return entry_id.rstrip("/").split("/")[-1]


def fetch_arxiv(
    search_query: str,
    start: int = 0,
    max_results: int = 25,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
) -> list[ArxivRecord]:
    params = {
        "search_query": search_query,
        "start": start,
        "max_results": max_results,
        "sortBy": "submittedDate",
        "sortOrder": "descending",
    }

    headers = {
        "User-Agent": "BibliotecaInvestigacion/1.0 contacto@example.org",
        "Accept": "application/atom+xml",
    }

    response = requests.get(
        API_URL,
        params=params,
        headers=headers,
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()

    feed = feedparser.parse(response.content)
    if getattr(feed, "bozo", False):
        raise ValueError(f"Respuesta Atom invÃ¡lida: {feed.bozo_exception}")

    records: list[ArxivRecord] = []

    for entry in feed.entries:
        pdf_url = None
        for link in getattr(entry, "links", []):
            if link.get("type") == "application/pdf":
                pdf_url = link.get("href")
                break

        records.append(
            ArxivRecord(
                arxiv_id=normalize_arxiv_id(entry.id),
                title=" ".join(entry.title.split()),
                summary=" ".join(entry.summary.split()),
                authors=tuple(author.name for author in entry.authors),
                published=entry.published,
                updated=entry.updated,
                categories=tuple(tag.term for tag in entry.tags),
                pdf_url=pdf_url,
            )
        )

    return records


def main() -> None:
    records = fetch_arxiv("cat:cs.CL AND abs:retrieval", max_results=10)

    for record in records:
        print(record.arxiv_id, record.title)

    # Espera antes de cualquier llamada posterior.
    time.sleep(3)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

# 2265. Ejemplo con `ElementTree`

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import requests


API_URL = "https://export.arxiv.org/api/query"

NS = {
    "atom": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom",
    "opensearch": "http://a9.com/-/spec/opensearch/1.1/",
    "arxiv": "http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom",
}


def fetch_titles(query: str) -> list[str]:
    response = requests.get(
        API_URL,
        params={
            "search_query": query,
            "start": 0,
            "max_results": 10,
        },
        headers={
            "User-Agent": "ProyectoDocumental/1.0 contacto@example.org",
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()

    root = ET.fromstring(response.content)
    titles: list[str] = []

    for entry in root.findall("atom:entry", NS):
        title = entry.findtext("atom:title", default="", namespaces=NS)
        titles.append(" ".join(title.split()))

    return titles
```

# 2375. Cliente Python bÃ¡sico

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Iterator

import requests


OAI_NS = {"oai": "http://www.openarchives.org/OAI/2.0/"}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OAIHeader:
    identifier: str
    datestamp: str
    sets: tuple[str, ...]
    deleted: bool


class OAIError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def request_oai(
    base_url: str,
    params: dict[str, str],
    *,
    timeout: float = 60.0,
) -> ET.Element:
    response = requests.get(
        base_url,
        params=params,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": "RepositorioInstitucional/1.0 contacto@example.org",
            "Accept": "application/xml, text/xml;q=0.9",
        },
        timeout=timeout,
    )
    response.raise_for_status()

    root = ET.fromstring(response.content)

    error = root.find("oai:error", OAI_NS)
    if error is not None:
        code = error.attrib.get("code", "unknown")
        message = (error.text or "").strip()
        raise OAIError(f"{code}: {message}")

    return root


def list_identifiers(
    base_url: str,
    metadata_prefix: str,
    *,
    from_date: str | None = None,
    set_spec: str | None = None,
) -> Iterator[OAIHeader]:
    params = {
        "verb": "ListIdentifiers",
        "metadataPrefix": metadata_prefix,
    }

    if from_date:
        params["from"] = from_date
    if set_spec:
        params["set"] = set_spec

    while True:
        root = request_oai(base_url, params)

        for header in root.findall(
            ".//oai:ListIdentifiers/oai:header",
            OAI_NS,
        ):
            yield OAIHeader(
                identifier=header.findtext(
                    "oai:identifier",
                    default="",
                    namespaces=OAI_NS,
                ),
                datestamp=header.findtext(
                    "oai:datestamp",
                    default="",
                    namespaces=OAI_NS,
                ),
                sets=tuple(
                    element.text or ""
                    for element in header.findall("oai:setSpec", OAI_NS)
                ),
                deleted=header.attrib.get("status") == "deleted",
            )

        token_element = root.find(
            ".//oai:ListIdentifiers/oai:resumptionToken",
            OAI_NS,
        )
        token = (token_element.text or "").strip() if token_element is not None else ""

        if not token:
            break

        params = {
            "verb": "ListIdentifiers",
            "resumptionToken": token,
        }
```

El endpoint y el contacto del `User-Agent` deben sustituirse por valores institucionales reales.

# 2528. Listado en Python

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import boto3
from botocore.config import Config


def list_objects(
    bucket: str,
    prefix: str,
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    s3 = boto3.client(
        "s3",
        config=Config(
            retries={
                "max_attempts": 8,
                "mode": "adaptive",
            }
        ),
    )

    paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
    objects: list[dict[str, object]] = []

    for page in paginator.paginate(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Prefix=prefix,
        RequestPayer="requester",
    ):
        for item in page.get("Contents", []):
            objects.append(
                {
                    "key": item["Key"],
                    "size": item["Size"],
                    "etag": item.get("ETag"),
                    "last_modified": item["LastModified"],
                }
            )

    return objects
```

La operaciÃ³n `ListObjectsV2` acepta el parÃ¡metro `RequestPayer` para confirmar que el solicitante asume los cargos. ([DocumentaciÃ³n de AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/boto3/latest/reference/services/s3/client/list_objects_v2.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com "list_objects_v2 - Boto3 1.43.51 documentation"))

# 2529. Descarga en Python

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import boto3
from boto3.s3.transfer import TransferConfig


def download_object(
    bucket: str,
    key: str,
    destination: Path,
) -> None:
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    s3 = boto3.client("s3")

    transfer_config = TransferConfig(
        multipart_threshold=128 * 1024 * 1024,
        multipart_chunksize=64 * 1024 * 1024,
        max_concurrency=4,
        use_threads=True,
    )

    s3.download_file(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Key=key,
        Filename=str(destination),
        ExtraArgs={
            "RequestPayer": "requester",
        },
        Config=transfer_config,
    )
```

Las transferencias administradas de boto3 pueden dividir objetos grandes en partes y utilizar varios hilos. ([DocumentaciÃ³n de AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/boto3/latest/reference/services/s3/client/download_fileobj.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com "download_fileobj - Boto3 1.43.51 documentation"))
